title: The Final Judgment
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The final judgment is God’s righteous judgment of all people through Jesus Christ. Every hidden thing will be brought to light, evil will be judged, and God’s justice will be fully displayed.
summary: The final judgment is God’s righteous judgment of all people through Jesus Christ. Every hidden thing will be brought to light, evil will be judged, and God’s justice will be fully displayed.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the appointed Judge of the living and the dead. The Savior who offers mercy now will judge righteously when all people stand before Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The final judgment teaches that history is moving toward God’s righteous evaluation. Nothing hidden from people is hidden from God.

Christ will judge with perfect righteousness. Human courts fail, memories fade, motives are misunderstood, and injustice often seems to win, but God’s judgment will be true.

For those outside Christ, final judgment is terrifying. For believers, judgment is not condemnation, because Christ has borne their guilt, yet their lives still matter before the Lord.

This doctrine reveals the seriousness of sin and the certainty of justice. It also magnifies grace, because the only safe refuge from judgment is Jesus Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
The final judgment confronts both denial and despair. It denies the lie that evil will never be answered, and it comforts those who have suffered when justice seemed absent.

This doctrine also calls believers to holy seriousness. The God who saves by grace also judges righteously, and every life is lived before His face.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live before God with honesty and reverence. Bring sin into the light now, flee to Christ for mercy, and entrust injustice to the righteous Judge. Let final judgment move you toward holiness, humility, and faithful witness.
